notes.detail: Karnataka only; field crops (not processed products); costs stop at farm-gate readiness. Primary units ₹/acre and quintal/acre; source units kept in separate columns.

(1) Ragi family-labour amount and returns, TE 2021-22 (CACP via S03). (2) Jowar and ragi A2+FL and C2 per quintal, FY 2019-20 (S04). (3) KAPC state estimate for ragi (S05). (4) Tur yield, production and area (S08, S09, S16); maize production (S08). (5) Zone framework, irrigated share and rainfall for five zones (S10, S11). (6) Drought-impact area figures 2023 and 2026 (S13, S14).

All rows scoped 'All-India CACP ...' are national benchmarks used only because no Karnataka figure was retrievable. They are labelled in every table and chart and must not be quoted as Karnataka observations.

Years differ across rows (FY 2019-20 Karnataka; TE 2021-22; KMS 2022-23; KMS 2023-24; RMS 2025-26). Cost concepts differ (A2, A2+FL, C2; KAPC method). Projected vs actual also differ. The dashboard shows the year next to every value.

Implied cost per acre = ₹/quintal × projected yield (q/acre). Family labour = A2+FL minus A2 (or returns difference for Karnataka ragi). Tur normal yield = production ÷ area. All are formulas; no value was typed in as a result.
No retrieved source gives separate rainfed and irrigated costs/yields. Cells are blank and formula-ready (Rainfed vs Irrigated sheet).

Yield-loss percentages, extra expenditure, re-sowing/rescue cost, drainage cost and change in cost per quintal are blank: no measured Karnataka values were retrieved. Reported 2023 and 2026 drought figures are area and damage-band claims by the state, not yield measurements. Vulnerability ratings are analyst judgement.

(a) Karnataka cost of cultivation by component for all 11 crops (the DES Cost of Cultivation Scheme and CACP state tables hold this); (b) district and zone yield/cost; (c) rainfed vs irrigated split; (d) wheat, chana, urad, moong and horse gram cost of any kind for Karnataka; (e) horse gram has no cost series anywhere retrieved; (f) rainfall/GCA for 5 of 10 zones; (g) measured yield losses by hazard; (h) agronomy values are unverified recommendations.

Pull DES Karnataka district-season-crop area-production-yield (dataful dataset 4561 lists 1997-98 to 2024-25) for yields; request Cost of Cultivation Scheme unit-level data for Karnataka; open the CACP Price Policy report appendices for state-wise Karnataka cost per hectare by component; verify agronomy against UAS PoP 2023.

Formulas recalculated and checked for errors; all 11 crops present on the dashboard, cost, risk, rainfed and composition sheets; conversions use 2.47105; blanks are empty or '' (never zero); no cost beyond farm gate is included. Source URLs were not live-tested (restricted network) - they are the exact URLs returned by search.
